description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the 'NationalityService' in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods for various functionalities of the NationalityService, such as retrieving, deleting, and searching nationalities, using mock objects to simulate database interactions.

classes.name: NationalityServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'NationalityService' component in the OrangeHRM application, verifying its methods for retrieving, deleting, and searching nationalities with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, setting up the NationalityService instance and loading fixture data into the test database.

methods.name: testGetNationalityList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of a list of nationalities using a mocked DAO to return predefined data.

methods.name: testGetNationalityById
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly fetches a nationality by its ID using a mocked DAO.

methods.name: testDeleteNationalities
methods.description: Checks that the service deletes a list of nationalities and returns the correct count via the DAO mock.

methods.name: testGetNationalityByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a nationality by name through the service with a mocked DAO.
